claims.evidence: Each MaxQuant experiment PULSE_SB_DAC_R<n> (human search) = SBDAC_R<n> (TINPAT search; identical file sets and fractions, asserted in make_tables.py) is one mix of a DMSO culture (medium) and a DAC+SB939 culture (heavy), HpH-fractionated into 8 concatenated fractions: R1 = 20180329_QE1_DS_SBDAC_R1_F1-F8; R2 = 20180410_QE1_DS_SBDAC_R2_F1-F8; R3 = 20180420_QE1_DS_SBDAC_4h_2mio_C1T1_F1-F6,F8 (no F7 deposited or searched); R4 = 20180504_QE1_DS_SBDAC_C3T3_2mio_4h_F1-F8; R5 = 20180504_QE1_DS_SBDAC_CT_08_4h_F2-F8 (no F1 deposited or searched); R6 = 20180509_QE1_DS_SBDAC_CT_08_4h_R2_F1-F8; R7 = 20180509_QE1_DS_SBDAC_CT_08_4h_R3_F1-F8. Paper: 'entries reporting at least 4 valid values in the 7 biological replicates'. One source per culture per mix, so no name denotes two physical samples. The light channel of each mix is a separate source name per mix ('pre-existing-proteome-pool'): it is the unlabelled material of the two cultures of that mix, not a reused shared pool.

limitations: PARTIAL SCOPE: 54 of 111 raw files are annotated (the QE-HF AHA-pulse SILAC experiment that the paper reports, 7 biological replicates x 8 HpH fractions minus 2 missing fractions). 57 raw files are left out and recorded in annotations/BLOCKED.md.

Blocked (channel map undocumented): 48 Orbitrap Fusion runs 20171120_FS1_DP_SB939_1A_test, _SB939_A2-A8, _SB939_B1-B8, 20171121_FS1_DP_DAC_A1-A8, _DAC_B1-B8, _SB_DAC_A1-A8, _SB_DAC_B1-B8 (MaxQuant experiments STABLE_SB939, STABLE_DAC, STABLE_SB_DAC_R1, STABLE_SB_DAC_R2; Multiplicity 2, light vs Arg10;Lys8). Neither the paper, its supplementary files nor the PRIDE protocol describes this 'STABLE' experiment or which channel carried which treatment. The deposited H/L ratios anti-correlate with Supplementary Data 5 DAC+SB939 vs DMSO (r = -0.34 to -0.54; PAGE2/DAZL strongly light-high), which suggests light = treated and heavy = control, but campaign rule 6 needs an explicit source, and the identity of the A vs B series inside STABLE_SB939 and STABLE_DAC (both numbered fractions 1-8 in one experiment) is also undocumented.

Blocked (sample identity undocumented): 9 unfractionated QE-HF runs 20180322_QE1_DS_SBDAC_Translatome_1, _Translatome_2, 20180329_QE1_DS_SBDAC_R2_Unfractionated, 20180413_QE1_DS_SBDAC_4h_R1, _4h_R2, 20180504_QE1_DS_SBDAC_C3T3_2mio_4h_Unfrac, 20180504_QE1_DS_SBDAC_CT_08_4h_Unfrac, 20180509_QE1_DS_SBDAC_CT_08_4h_Unfrac_2, _Unfrac_3 (TINPAT-search experiments SBDAC_NF_R1-R9; not in the human search). Same 3-plex labelling, but the paper does not mention them and nothing says whether they are aliquots of the fractionated mixes R1-R7 or separate cultures, so source names and biological replicate numbers cannot be assigned honestly.

Light channel: encoded as a per-mix 'pre-existing-proteome-pool' source (treatment not applicable), following campaign precedent PXD016211. After AHA enrichment of newly synthesised proteins this channel carries little signal; it is searched (Multiplicity 3) but is not a study condition.

Two MaxQuant searches cover the 54 annotated files (human UniProt, MaxQuant 1.6.8.0; TINPAT ORF database, 2.0.3.0) with identical modifications, labels and tolerances, so one set of search columns describes both. Min. unique peptides differs (2 vs 1), which the SDRF does not encode.
Precursor tolerance 4.5 ppm is inferred from 'default settings' plus the evidence.txt mass-error bound; parameters.txt does not record it.
Alkylation: both iodoacetamide (55 mM, before click chemistry) and chloroacetamide (33 mM, on-bead with TCEP) were used; only CAA fits the single-valued column.
Treatment doses/durations come from the general 'Cell culture and treatment' section (500 nM each) and the pulse section (DAC 72 h, SB939 18 h); the pulse section itself does not restate the dose.
reconcile BLOCKER cleavage_agent_unsupported is a false positive: the PRIDE record defers digestion details to the paper, and the paper names Trypsin/LysC (see validation.txt).
Independent review not run here (external reviewer hand-off; REVIEW_PENDING_EXTERNAL).
